title: Alpha or Unbound?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Compare Alpha School and Unbound Academy by placing nine facts as true of Alpha only, Unbound only, or both.

learningObjectives: The learner will compare Alpha School and Unbound Academy by placing nine facts as true of Alpha only, Unbound only, or both, correctly placing at least eight of nine on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Alpha School, Unbound Academy, 2 Hour Learning, Alpha adult guides, and "software is not the model," from the sections "Case 1" and "Case 2" in Chapter 22.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify one item at a time with immediate feedback; first-attempt scoring
keyQuestions: What do the two schools share?
What does only one of them have?
commonMisconceptions: The two schools are the same program.
Using the same software means getting the same results.
A free school and a tuition school differ only in price.
assessmentOpportunities: Which school uses the 2 Hour Learning software?
Which school has an in-person afternoon led by adult guides?
Do the two schools differ only in price?
